description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request.
The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。默认值：**10**。取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

description.zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

title.zh: 查询IPsec连接的跨账号授权信息
title.en: Query cross-account authorization information of an iPsec-VPN connection
